repos_data.description: Go version manager, written in Go. Super simple tool to install and manage Go versions. Install go without root. Gobrew doesn't require shell rehash.

✨ A complete and self-contained solution for developers of any qualification to create a production-ready project with backend (Go), frontend (JavaScript, TypeScript) and deploy automation (Ansible, Docker) by running only one CLI command.
goscaf generates opinionated, production-quality Go project boilerplate via an interactive CLI. Stop copy-pasting skeleton code between projects.
Frictionless way of managing project-specific commands
Fast manager for Go-installed binaries in $GOBIN: update, export/import, and migrate toolsets across machines
open source CLI to control Anythink from the command line

High-performance configuration management framework for Go applications with zero-allocation performance, universal format support (JSON, YAML, TOML, HCL, INI, Properties), and an ultra-fast CLI powered by Orpheus.
